source.name: BGSU RNA 3D Motif Atlas / FR3D loops
source.note: Loop -> motif-group assignments are parsed from the HTML motifs page (no JSON endpoint). 'problematic' loops are listed by the Atlas with a reason and carry no motif group. Assignment types: 'member' = the loop is an instance of the group in the current release; 'homologous'/'geometric' = the loop is mapped to the group through a release loop (motif_group_via_loop_id).

counting_rules.loop_observation: one FR3D loop id = one observation, even when its nucleotides span several chains
counting_rules.junction: J3 and J4 are separate categories; any combined junction summary is a set union of loops/instances/entries
counting_rules.merged_loops: a loop whose nucleotide set is exactly the union of two other non-problematic loops of the same entry that share exactly two nucleotides (one closing pair) is a BGSU merged loop (decomposition.role = merged); its two parts are superseded (decomposition.superseded_by) and are not counted in the HL/IL/J tracks. Nested merges supersede every intermediate loop. All records are kept. Inferred from the BGSU download, which does not flag merged loops
